description: Neuro-Symbolic SIF Risk Engine — Physical Safety Constraint Rules Graph

rules.name: Pressure Bleed / Double Block Isolation
rules.required_condition: Secondary isolation valve (Valve B) confirmed CLOSED and verified
rules.hazard_if_missing: Unverified Energy Isolation — Secondary Barrier Status UNKNOWN. Upstream pressure may re-communicate through unverified valve.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #3: Verify Isolation Before Work Begins
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 6.2.1 — Secondary Valve Verification in Bleed Operations
rules.historical_precedent: 2020 Baghjan-5 Well Blowout — Premature barrier removal during pressure operations; secondary valve physically unverified
rules.mitigation: Immediately halt downstream work. Physically verify and document secondary valve (Valve B) closed position via valve position indicator and downstream pressure gauge reading.

rules.name: Hotwork — Gas-Free Certification Required
rules.required_condition: Gas-free certificate issued by safety officer; fire watch assigned; area tested < 10% LEL
rules.hazard_if_missing: Ignition Source in Potentially Hazardous Atmosphere — flammable gas or vapor ignition risk without confirmed gas-free status.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #2: Conduct a Gas Test When Required
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-116: Fire Prevention and Hotwork Control
rules.historical_precedent: 1988 Piper Alpha Disaster — Condensate pump reinstated during hotwork; gas release found ignition source
rules.mitigation: Stop all hotwork immediately. Conduct gas test with calibrated detector. Issue gas-free certificate valid for maximum 2 hours. Assign fire watch before resuming.

rules.name: Suspended Load — Exclusion Zone Required
rules.required_condition: Exclusion zone established and barricaded; all personnel clear of load path; lift supervisor confirmed
rules.hazard_if_missing: Personnel potentially within drop zone of suspended load — risk of crush injury or fatality from load drop.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #7: Do Not Place Yourself Under a Suspended Load
rules.historical_precedent: Multiple fatalities industry-wide from dropped objects during crane operations without established exclusion zones
rules.mitigation: Immediately stop the lift. Establish exclusion zone equal to lift height + 20%. Verify all personnel are outside zone before resuming. Assign dedicated lift supervisor.

rules.name: H2S Zone Entry — Breathing Apparatus Required
rules.required_condition: Positive-pressure SCBA or supplied air worn; personal H2S monitor active; buddy system in place
rules.hazard_if_missing: Personnel in H2S Zone without confirmed respiratory protection — risk of H2S poisoning at potentially IDLH (100 ppm) concentrations.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #12: Follow Requirements for Working with H2S
rules.historical_precedent: Multiple fatalities from H2S exposure in confined and semi-confined sour gas areas where BA equipment was available but not worn
rules.mitigation: Immediately withdraw personnel from H2S zone. Issue SCBA and buddy assignments. Re-enter only with full protective equipment and continuous H2S monitoring.

rules.name: High-Pressure Line Opening — LOTO + Zero Pressure Verification
rules.required_condition: LOTO applied; pressure verified zero at work point; bleed confirmed open; PTW in place
rules.hazard_if_missing: Stored pressure energy not confirmed zero at work point — risk of high-pressure fluid jet, hydrocarbon release, or sudden pressurization during work.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #3: Verify Isolation Before Work Begins
rules.iogp_clause: Clause 3.4 — Energy Verification at Work Point
rules.historical_precedent: 2005 Texas City Refinery — Raffinate splitter overpressure; stored energy in atmospheric vent not recognized; BLEVE killed 15
rules.mitigation: Stop work immediately. Verify LOTO applied at all energy sources. Test for zero pressure at the actual work point (not isolation point). Document gauge reading. Resume only when verified.

rules.name: Confined Space Entry — Atmospheric Testing + Standby Required
rules.required_condition: Atmospheric testing completed (O2, LEL, H2S); standby person posted; rescue equipment ready; confined space permit issued
rules.hazard_if_missing: Atmospheric conditions in confined space UNKNOWN — risk of oxygen deficiency, toxic gas accumulation (H2S, CO), or flammable atmosphere exposure.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #6: Follow Requirements for Working in a Confined Space
rules.iogp_clause: Clause 6.1 — Atmospheric Testing; Clause 6.3 — Standby Person
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-RP-175: Safety in Petroleum Refineries — Confined Space
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 5.1 — Pre-Entry Testing; Clause 5.2 — Standby Person Requirements
rules.historical_precedent: Numerous fatalities from O2-deficient atmospheres in vessels and tanks across oil & gas industry where testing was assumed rather than performed
rules.mitigation: Immediately withdraw all personnel from confined space. Conduct full atmospheric testing. Post trained standby person. Set up rescue equipment. Issue formal confined space permit.

rules.name: Electrical Equipment Work — LOTO Verification Required
rules.required_condition: LOTO applied and verified; voltage tested at work point with approved tester; arc flash PPE worn
rules.hazard_if_missing: Electrical isolation not confirmed at work point — risk of electric shock, electrocution, or arc flash injury.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #3: Verify Isolation Before Work Begins
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-137: Electrical Safety in Petroleum Industry
rules.historical_precedent: Multiple electrocution fatalities from assumption of de-energized state without verification at the actual work point in oil & gas facilities
rules.mitigation: Stop electrical work immediately. Apply LOTO at the disconnecting means. Use approved voltage tester to verify zero voltage at the work point. Don arc flash PPE rated for incident energy level.

rules.name: Hazardous Chemical Handling — PPE and SDS Review Required
rules.required_condition: Chemical-resistant gloves worn; chemical splash goggles/face shield on; SDS reviewed; emergency shower location known
rules.hazard_if_missing: Hazardous chemical handling without confirmed PPE compliance — risk of chemical burn, eye injury, or toxic exposure.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #5: Do Not Walk Past an Unsafe Act or Condition
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-RP-147: Safety in Handling Hazardous Chemicals
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 5.1 — PPE Requirements; Clause 5.3 — SDS Availability
rules.historical_precedent: Chemical splash injuries are among the most preventable yet frequent injuries in oil & gas chemical handling operations
rules.mitigation: Stop chemical handling. Issue appropriate chemical-resistant PPE (gloves, goggles, apron). Conduct SDS review. Confirm emergency shower location within 10 seconds travel time.

rules.name: Non-Routine Work — Valid Permit to Work Required
rules.required_condition: Valid Permit to Work issued and displayed at work site; all conditions satisfied before work start
rules.hazard_if_missing: Work potentially proceeding without valid Permit to Work — risk of uncontrolled work, missed hazard controls, and conflict with concurrent activities.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #1: Work with a Valid Permit to Work When Required
rules.iogp_clause: Never: Work without a Permit to Work when one is required
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 3.1 — PTW Applicability; Clause 3.3 — PTW Validity
rules.historical_precedent: 1988 Piper Alpha — PTW system failed during shift handover; condensate pump started while maintenance was ongoing
rules.mitigation: Stop all work immediately. Verify PTW status with area authority. Issue new PTW if required. Do not restart work until a valid PTW is in place and all conditions are satisfied.

rules.name: Working at Height — Fall Arrest System Required
rules.required_condition: Full body harness worn and connected to certified anchor point; fall arrest system inspected; work at height permit in place
rules.hazard_if_missing: Personnel working at height without confirmed fall protection — risk of fatal fall from elevation.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #11: Follow Requirements for Working at Height
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-GDN-206: Safety in Working at Height
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 3.1 — Fall Protection Mandatory; Clause 3.3 — Anchor Point Certification
rules.historical_precedent: Falls from height are the second leading cause of fatality in the oil and gas industry, with many occurring from scaffolding without certified harness anchorage
rules.mitigation: Stop all work at height. Issue and inspect full body harness. Identify and verify certified anchor points. Issue working at height permit. Re-inspect scaffold before resuming.

rules.name: Flammable Liquid Transfer — Bonding and Earthing Required
rules.required_condition: Earthing cable connected between tanker and earth point; bonding cable connected between tanker and receiving vessel; continuity verified
rules.hazard_if_missing: Static electricity accumulation during fuel transfer without bonding/earthing — risk of incendive spark discharge and flammable vapor ignition.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #2: Conduct a Gas Test When Required (adjacent hazard)
rules.iogp_clause: Flammable atmosphere control during transfer operations
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-117: Static Electricity Hazards in Petroleum Industry
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 4.1 — Bonding Requirement; Clause 4.2 — Earthing Requirement
rules.historical_precedent: Multiple fuel truck fires from static discharge during top-loading operations without earthing cable connections across oil & gas logistics
rules.mitigation: Stop transfer immediately. Connect dedicated earthing cable with continuity indicator. Connect bonding cable between source and receiving vessel. Verify continuity before restarting transfer.

rules.name: ESD/PSV Safety System Bypass — MoC Required
rules.required_condition: Management of Change (MoC) approved; compensatory measures documented; duration limited and tracked; control room notified
rules.hazard_if_missing: Safety-critical system bypassed without confirmed Management of Change approval — critical safety barrier removed without compensatory measures.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #4: Obtain Authorization Before Overriding Safety-Critical Equipment
rules.iogp_clause: Clause 4.2 — Simultaneous bypass of multiple protection layers forbidden
rules.oisd_clause: Clause 6.3 — MoC Requirement for Safety System Bypass
rules.historical_precedent: 2010 Deepwater Horizon — Multiple safety barrier bypasses (BOP test misinterpreted, centralizers omitted, lock-down sleeve not run) compounded without formal MoC; 11 fatalities
rules.mitigation: Immediately restore bypassed safety systems if possible. If bypass must continue, initiate emergency MoC process. Implement maximum manual compensation (15-min pressure monitoring). Notify Safety Manager and Operations Manager.

rules.name: Structural Pin Removal — Line-of-Fire & Trajectory Hazard
rules.required_condition: Rigman positioned clear of out-direction of blow; pin holder standing offset; trajectory barrier established
rules.hazard_if_missing: Rigman standing in direct line of fire of high-velocity projectile pin — risk of severe blunt force trauma or fatality.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #5: Do Not Place Yourself in the Line of Fire
rules.iogp_clause: Line of Fire & Energy Release Protection
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-GDN-205: Safety in Structural Maintenance & Rig Operations
rules.oisd_clause: Section 5 — Line of Fire Trajectory Controls
rules.historical_precedent: Multiple severe injuries across rig workover operations during structural pin removal without offset positioning
rules.mitigation: Do not hold pin when hammering. If holding is required, use holding tongs and stand completely offset from the expulsion trajectory.

rules.name: Line Testing Joint Tightening — Manual Tool Tethering & Drop Risk
rules.required_condition: Impact tools tethered with safety lanyard; area below barricaded; full PPE worn
rules.hazard_if_missing: Manual impact tool used at height or pressurized line without tool tethering — risk of dropped object impact injury to crew below.
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-GDN-205: Safety in Lifting & Material Handling
rules.historical_precedent: Dropped hammer incidents during pressure line joint tightening causing head and limb injuries on rig floors
rules.mitigation: Ensure all manual impact tools are attached to certified tool lanyards. Barricade drop zone below joint tightening operations.

rules.name: Derrick Floor & Chemical Store — Eyewash Station Maintenance
rules.required_condition: Eyewash station inspected weekly, filled with clean potable water, and verified unblocked
rules.hazard_if_missing: Emergency eyewash station dry, contaminated, or unserviceable on derrick floor or chemical store — risk of permanent eye damage during chemical splash or mud exposure.
rules.iogp_rule: IOGP Rule #5: Maintain Emergency Response Readiness
rules.oisd_standard: OISD-RP-147: Safety in Handling Hazardous Chemicals
rules.historical_precedent: Delayed eye flushing due to dry or dirty eyewash stations resulting in severe chemical eye injuries
rules.mitigation: Immediately clean eyewash basin, flush fluid lines, refill with clean potable water, and log weekly inspection on the derrick floor check sheet.
